## Problem 1: Getting started

Run the following code to check how many cores your computer has

```{r}
install.packages("parallel")

```

What does setting the `logical` argument to `FALSE` do? 



## Problem 2: loop de loop

The following code computes a quantity based on a "generalized regression estimator" and estimates its variance by bootstrapping with 100,000 bootstrap samples. Here, we are estimating the average biomass (`DRYBIO_AG_TPA_live_ADJ`) in a particular county in Oregon. 


```{r}
library(mase)
library(saeczi)
data(pop)
data(samp)

samp_list <- samp %>%
  group_by(COUNTYFIPS) %>%
  group_split()
pop_list <- pop %>%
  group_by(COUNTYFIPS) %>%
  group_split()

greg(y = samp_list[[1]]$DRYBIO_AG_TPA_live_ADJ,
     N = nrow(pop_list[[1]]),
     xsample = samp_list[[1]][c("tcc16", "elev")],
     xpop = pop_list[[1]][c("tcc16", "elev")],
     var_est = TRUE,
     var_method = "bootstrapSRS",
     B = 10000,
     datatype = "raw")
```
